title: Descent of extended-ideal membership through an injective tensor map
statement: Let k be a field, A and H commutative k-algebras, f:A→H an injective k-linear map, J an ideal of A, and t∈A⊗_k A. Extend J to A⊗_k H along the algebra homomorphism a↦a⊗1. If (id_A⊗f)(t) belongs to this extended ideal, then t belongs to the k-linear span of all a⊗b with a∈J and b∈A.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [Algebra k H] (f : A →ₗ[k] H) (_hf : Function.Injective f) (J : Ideal A) (t : TensorProduct k A A) (_ht : TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : A →ₗ[k] A) f t ∈ Ideal.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[k] TensorProduct k A H).toRingHom J), t ∈ Submodule.span k {z : TensorProduct k A A | ∃ a ∈ J, ∃ b : A, z = TensorProduct.tmul k a b}
